name: Windfury Ridge
summary: Windfury Ridge looms over Mulgore’s pastures, where harpies nest among wolves and cougars. Its slopes threaten travelers, while tauren hunters prize the harpies’ feathers.

sections.title: A Perilous Perch
sections.body: Windfury Ridge rises above Mulgore’s plains, where Windfury harpies nest among the crags. They swoop on wanderers who pass too close to the hills. Prairie wolves and mountain cougars prowl the rocky slopes, making this border of the tauren heartland dangerous. Tauren warriors hunt the harpies, whose iridescent feathers are sought in Thunder Bluff for ceremonial garments worn at feasts and weddings.

faq.answer: Windfury Ridge is dangerous because prairie wolves and cougars prowl its slopes, while harpies nest along the heights. Harpies dive from the crags at intruders who come near their nests.

faq.q: Why do the tauren hunt the harpies on Windfury Ridge?
faq.answer: Tauren hunt Windfury harpies to defend the borders and gather their brilliant feathers. The plumes are woven into ceremonial headdresses and decorations for feasts and weddings.
Windfury Ridge lies on elevated bluffs in northern Mulgore, beyond Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the ridge as a recurring nuisance to young hunters and a source of ceremonial ornaments for marriages and seasonal gatherings.
As a hunter, you can use the steep slopes and cunning predators to practice tracking, beast taming, and range management.
